item.title: Stellar Tactics
item.description: With Stellar Tactics, I wanted to recreate the core gameplay from one of my favourite games, XCOM 2. XCOM is a turn-based tactics game where the player commands a squad of soldiers in a fight against alien invaders. The player must carefully move their soldiers across the battlefield to find and accomplish an objective, eliminating any alien threats as they go. This is the gameplay that I wanted to make in this prototype.

item.title: Fluffy Dog Studio - Co-op Unity Game Developer
item.description: At Fluffy Dog, I worked with a wide range of professionals to create a new mobile game: “Neopets: Tales of Dacardia.” Notable features I worked on included a minigame called the Activity Fixity, the game’s audio system, an overhaul of the game’s pet customization system, a system for limited-time events, replacing the UI framework, updating the quest system to support side-quests, and creating tools to aid designers with various tasks, such as adding dialogue and creating events. Communication, collaboration, and flexibility were all key skills that I regularly put to use as I worked together with designers, artists, producers, and my fellow developers.
